chunks: Whoever returns from Makkah while intending to perform hajj again the following year will have his lifespan increased.

key_terms.الْحَجَّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred destination of hajj
key_terms.يَنْوِي: intends, meaning a resolved inward intention

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for intending to perform hajj again after returning from Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages maintaining a sincere intention to return for hajj again. It presents that intention as a cause for increased lifespan, showing the spiritual merit and ongoing blessing connected to hajj.
